items.name: compute_tension
items.status_label: 🟢 LIVE_SUCCESSOR — same idea, different name/formula than any Java ancestor
items.formula: pairs = (i, i+6) for i in 0..5 on the 12-area vector; tension = Σ|A[i]-A[i+6]| (L1 abs-sum).

items.notes: **HWIKI-PLAIN-C:** algebra plain_lang polished 2026-08-04. **HWIKI-PLAIN-B:** plain_lang backfilled from formula/notes 2026-08-04. **HWIKI-OPEN-01 resolved 2026-07-23:** `(i,i+6)` is **not** geometrically antipodal after `get_aligned_area_coordinates`. Ran alignment on canonical adj: geometric antipodes remain `(0,3)(1,2)(4,7)(5,6)(8,11)(9,10)` (dot=-1); `(i,i+6)` dots are ±0.447 (~0.35π / ~0.65π), not antipodal. Live pairing is the combinatorial [[OPPOSITE_OFFSET]]=6 index convention for exclusion/tension — not a claim that area i faces area i+6 on the sphere. Differs from Java also in aggregator (L1 abs-sum vs L2 squares).
